title: Run it again next year, and remember who drew whom
problem: A family has to rebuild the same exchange every year, and nothing stops someone drawing the same person again.
why: This is the yearly reason to come back. Past pairings aren't stored anywhere today, and DrawNames users notice when an app forgets.

evidence.quote: Unfortunately if you have the same people and same amount of people and draw for future consecutive years, the odds of redrawing is 50/50. I would think it would remember, but I guess not.
My family and I used it both this and last year and we all got the same people!
An exchange can be redrawn, but only within the same exchange. There is no way to copy it or carry its history forward.

title: Add kids and relatives who have no email
problem: Every participant needs their own unique email, so two kids can't share a parent's address.
why: Parents are the core audience, and a family exchange with kids can't be set up honestly today.

evidence.quote: Adding children who don’t have email accounts is difficult.
exchange_participants requires an email that is unique within the exchange.

title: Let organizers see who is stuck
problem: After the draw, the organizer can't tell who has opened their match or who has an empty wishlist, so they chase everyone.
why: It turns the organizer from tech support into someone with a clear list of two people to text.

evidence.quote: Instead of the app notifying everyone that there were individual individuals who did not see their draw, only the organizer receives notifications that the draw is incomplete.
And as an administrator one cannot update other people’s emails.
No record of who opened their match exists. The organizer page shows nothing about this after the draw.

title: Rename or delete a wishlist, and turn off its link
problem: A wishlist can't be renamed or deleted, and a shared link can't be turned off, from the web app.
why: The API and service calls already exist, so this is the cheapest gap to close. People expect to be able to undo a share.

evidence.quote: PATCH and DELETE on wishlists and revoke_share exist in the API, and nothing in the web app calls them.

title: Paste a link and fill in the rest
problem: Any store link is accepted, but people still type the name, price and image by hand.
why: Competitors lose people by leaning toward Amazon. Working with every store is a real advantage, and auto-fill makes it obvious.

evidence.quote: Please make it easier to add items that are sold on sites other than Amazon.
If only Amazon links work, then I might as well use Amazon wishlist!
The "auto image select" feature pulls the wrong image more often than not

title: Save an idea from the phone in seconds
problem: There's no share sheet target and no photo capture, so an idea seen in a shop has to wait.
why: GOALS.md sets 5-second capture as a consumer goal, and Elfster users are angry about losing exactly this.

evidence.quote: I am a mobile user and used to be able to add wishes to my wishlist using any websites share button and selecting the Elfster app… that no longer works!
please add a feature so we can take pics and scan in store items and add to the list without having to use a browser to do so.

title: See your match without making an account
problem: Everyone in an exchange must create an account before they can join or see who they drew.
why: The relative in this audit faced a long form before seeing anything useful. A private link could remove that, but it needs care to keep matches secret.

evidence.quote: Every person in the exchange has to download the app and login.
I don’t like that it forces people to create profiles to view the list.
The sign-up form asks for first name, last name, email, optional phone and password before the invite can be accepted.

title: Bring your wishlist into an exchange
problem: A wishlist and an exchange wishlist are separate, so people retype the same wishes.
why: Small change, and it also lets people deliberately reuse last year's ideas instead of having old ones surface by accident.

evidence.quote: We used these app for 3 years and worst is this year, people sent gift’s from 2 year ago’s wish list?
I add items to a current wishlist but it somehow only adds it to a wishlist from two years ago.
exchange_wishlist_items has no link to wishlist_items.

title: Wishlists and claiming in the mobile app
problem: Standalone wishlists and claims only work on the web, so phone users can't see what's been taken.
why: Duplicate gifts are the classic failure of this category, and the protection stops at the browser.

evidence.quote: Both years, we’ve all received duplicate gifts because of these types of issues (and the gift-givers range from under 30’s to mid-80’s in age).
It would show that it was purchased on the individuals and who purchased it, but when we looked at other people's same list, it did not show that it was purchased.

title: Choose a currency
problem: Dollar signs are hard-coded, and exchanges and items have no currency.
why: Premium is priced in CAD, so this affects a market you already sell in.

evidence.quote: Nice app, but wishlist keeps defaulting to Amazon USA and USD even though currency /country has been set to CAD / Canada.
If you’re outside of those countries the app is useless

title: Control exchange emails
problem: Exchange mail ignores email preferences, and a giver gets one email per item their match adds.
why: A daily roundup and an off switch prevent the complaint before it starts.

evidence.quote: I want to receive notifications when the person I draw adds new items, or when someone has an upcoming birthday, NOT when it’s “Sagittarius SZN,” or Elfster wants to send me stupid ads for Fuzzy Crocs that I couldn’t care less about.
There is no way to turn off just the notifications that are ads or sweepstakes, etc.
notification_preferences covers three seasonal reminders only.

title: Warn when a match has an empty list
problem: A giver can open their match and find nothing, and only learns late.
why: The anonymous nudge exists. Telling the recipient early, before the giver has to ask, makes it work harder.

evidence.quote: I didn’t get anything for my person since I didn’t know what they had on their list until today.
It says 6 items but when I click on it, it says no items.
